create_DataGenerator: create a DataGenerator instance with batch_size, seq_length, and rng seed for meta-learning trajectory sampling
sample_sequences: sample a batch of one-hot encoded sequences with categorical probabilities and metadata from a DataGenerator
sample_params: sample meta-parameters that remain fixed within each trajectory for a given sample size
sample_from_params: generate sequences and categorical probabilities from a fixed set of trajectory parameters
sample_dummy: generate dummy sequences and empty logs for parameter initialization or spec checking
